title: Round the twist: spaghetti pig out
creator_credit: Australian Children's Television Foundation, Antonia Barnard, Steve Steve Jodrell and Paul Jennings
brief_description: Chaos reigns after a bolt of lightning hits the video remote control - it works on people! Pause, rewind and fast-forward have amusing consequences, particularly at the spaghetti eating competition.
